risks.title: E-mail label is placed on a separate form in index.html rather than with the contact form labels
risks.explanation: contact.html's form contains "Name:" and "Message:" labels but the email input has no label there; index.html contains a separate standalone form with "E-mail:" label. The three labels are not together on one contact form.
risks.suggestion: Confirm with the buyer whether all three labels are expected on one contact form; if so, add an "E-mail:" label to the email input in contact.html and get the stray index.html form removed.

limitations: Source-only review: label visibility, rendering and form submission behavior were not observed.

No browser or accessibility check was performed on label/input associations.
